died.name: Catherine of Aragon
died.cause: closing her last letter to her former husband, Henry VIII of England
died.last_words: Mine eyes desire thee only. Farewell.

died.name: François Fénelon
died.desc: French Roman Catholic archbishop, theologian and writer
died.last_words: Not my will, but thine be done.

died.name: Henry Arthur Jones
died.cause: when his nurse and his niece asked which of them he would prefer to stay with him
died.last_words: The prettier. Now fight for it.

died.name: Thomas F. Mantell
died.last_words: The object is directly ahead of and above me now, moving at about half my speed... It appears to be a metallic object or possibly reflection of Sun from a metallic object, and it is of tremendous size... I'm still climbing... I'm trying to close in for a better look.

died.name: Thomas Mantell
died.cause: The 25-year-old P-51 Mustang fighter pilot crashed while in pursuit of an unidentified flying object near Franklin, Kentucky, thus becoming the first person known to have died as a result of a UFO sighting. Officially, the object remains unidentified, though the most likely explanation is that it was a U.S. Navy Skyhook balloon.

died.name: Emperor Hirohito of Japan,
died.cause: a last message to Shoichi Fujimori, commissioner of Imperial Household Agency
died.last_words: I believe that the image of walking through, these turbulent times live on people's hearts for a long time.

born.name: Abd al-Rahman III
born.last_words: I have now reigned above fifty years in victory or peace; beloved by my subjects, dreaded by my enemies, and respected by my allies. Riches and honors, power and pleasure, have waited on my call, nor does any earthly blessing appear to have been wanting to my felicity. In this situation, I have diligently numbered the days of pure and genuine happiness which have fallen to my lot: they amount to Fourteen:-O man! place not thy confidence in this present world!

born.name: Princess Charlotte of Wales
born.last_words: You make me drunk. Pray leave me quiet. I feel it affects my head.

born.name: Millard Fillmore
born.cause: referring to soup he had eaten
